response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile does not match the core mandatory requirements of this role. Hands-on C++ experience is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments (2014–2015) writing C/C++ components, versus the required 5–10 years, and there is no evidence of Windows-platform systems development. The primary stack is JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with SQL listed generically rather than demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle depth. Financial-domain exposure is limited to a fintech investment platform (RIDE Capital) and does not include fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking systems. Strong engineering fundamentals and communication skills are present, but the gap on the two hard filters (C++ depth and capital-markets domain) is too large for this consulting engagement.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering track record across backend, web, and embedded systems
Strong software craftsmanship practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development
Excellent communication evidenced by conference talks, workshops, and course authoring
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ work, far below the 5–10 year requirement
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets/investment banking domain experience
No demonstrated Windows-platform development or SQL Server/Oracle depth

key_factors.factor: General senior engineering and communication ability
